Layer parameters are written exactly like this (any other torch.nn layer by its name alone, e.g. ReLU):
Conv1d/Conv2d/Conv3d/ConvTranspose2d(in=,out=,k=,s=,p=) plus g= only when groups is not 1; Linear(in=,out=,bias=True|False);
BatchNorm1d/BatchNorm2d/BatchNorm3d(features=); GroupNorm(features=<channels>); LayerNorm(shape=[64]);
MaxPool2d/AvgPool2d(k=,s=); AdaptiveAvgPool2d/AdaptiveMaxPool2d(out=); Dropout(p=); Embedding(num=,dim=); Flatten(start=,end=).
A kernel, stride or padding that is the same in every dimension is one number (k=3), otherwise a list with x between the values (k=[1x7]); LayerNorm over two dims is shape=[64x64].

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F

class LayerNormChannels(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_channels, eps=1e-06):
        super().__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_channels))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_channels))
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x):
        u = x.mean(1, keepdim=True)
        s = (x - u).pow(2).mean(1, keepdim=True)
        x = (x - u) / torch.sqrt(s + self.eps)
        x = self.weight[:, None, None] * x + self.bias[:, None, None]
        return x

class DepthwiseMLPBlock(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, drop_path=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.dwconv = nn.Conv2d(dim, dim, kernel_size=7, padding=3, groups=dim)
        self.norm = LayerNormChannels(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.pwconv1 = nn.Conv2d(dim, 4 * dim, kernel_size=1)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.pwconv2 = nn.Conv2d(self.pwconv1.out_channels, dim, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, tensor):
        shortcut = tensor
        tensor = self.dwconv(tensor)
        tensor = self.norm(tensor)
        tensor = self.pwconv1(tensor)
        tensor = self.act(tensor)
        tensor = self.pwconv2(tensor)
        tensor = shortcut + tensor
        return tensor
network = DepthwiseMLPBlock(16)
example_input = torch.randn(1, 16, 16, 16)

from typing import Callable, List, Optional
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch import Tensor

class Mlp(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features, act_layer=nn.GELU, drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features)
        self.act = act_layer()
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_features, in_features)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.drop(x)
        return x

class MixerLayer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, dim, seq_len, mlp_ratio=(0.5, 4.0), drop=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        tokens_dim, channels_dim = [int(r * dim) for r in mlp_ratio]
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp_tokens = Mlp(seq_len, tokens_dim, drop=drop)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.mlp_channels = Mlp(dim, channels_dim, drop=drop)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x + self.mlp_tokens(self.norm1(x).transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
        x = x + self.mlp_channels(self.norm2(x))
        return x

class Mixer(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, num_classes=10, img_size=32, in_chans=3, patch_size=4, num_blocks=4, embed_dim=64, mlp_ratio=(0.5, 4.0), drop_rate=0.0, drop_path_rate=0.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(in_chans, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
        num_patches = (img_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[MixerLayer(embed_dim, num_patches, mlp_ratio, drop=drop_rate) for i in range(num_blocks)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim, eps=1e-06)
        self.head_drop = nn.Dropout(drop_rate)
        self.head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes) if num_classes > 0 else nn.Identity()

    def forward_features(self, x):
        x = self.stem(x)
        x = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        x = self.blocks(x)
        x = self.norm(x)
        return x

    def forward_head(self, x, pre_logits=False):
        x = x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.head_drop(x)
        return x if pre_logits else self.head(x)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.forward_features(x)
        x = self.forward_head(x)
        return x
